title: Opera GX profile
whyItMatters: The Opera GX profile holds history, cookies, saved logins, bookmarks and GX settings. It shows the browser was used and which sites kept the person signed in.
source: Opera Help, Crashes and issues: Get the profile and data folder paths from About Opera or opera:about/ (Roaming path confirmed on Windows 11) - https://help.opera.com/en/latest/crashes-and-issues/
notes: Verified on this PC at %APPDATA%/Opera Software/Opera GX Stable/Default/Preferences. Opera GX keeps data in Roaming, unlike most Chromium browsers. Opera Stable and side profiles use sibling folders.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Opera GX, export saved passwords from the password manager and bookmarks as HTML before removing anything.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of your Opera account in the browser settings so synced data stays with the account.
steps: Uninstall Opera GX from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the Opera GX profile folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes the Opera GX profile on this PC: history, bookmarks, saved logins, cookies and GX settings.
